description: This is a Java interface file defining the ProtocolAdapter interface within the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package. It specifies methods for converting between Signals and Adaptables, handling different message types, and includes static utility methods related to signal channels.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapter
classes.description: An interface defining methods for mapping Signals to Adaptables and vice versa, handling different signal types, and utility methods for channel determination.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable to a Signal, which may be a Command, CommandResponse, or Event.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Signal to an Adaptable, with various overloads for specific signal types and channels.

methods.name: headerTranslator
methods.description: Returns the HeaderTranslator responsible for this ProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Static utility: Checks if a Signal belongs to the live channel.

methods.name: determineChannel
methods.description: Static utility: Determines the channel of a Signal, defaulting to the header or based on signal type.

methods.name: determineDefaultChannel
methods.description: Static utility: Determines the default channel based on signal type.
